data.home: Welcome to East Bay Chamber Music! See below for details for the next performance and visit the information page to learn more about EBCM.
data.information:
East Bay Chamber Music (EBCM) is a volunteer-run group focused on facilitating amateur chamber music opportunities in the East Bay (San Francisco Bay Area). There will be at least one set performance date per quarter that people can sign up for, but groups are encouraged to organize their own recitals and invite others to take part via EBCM announcements.

Each group is responsible for managing their own rehearsals - choosing repertoire, renting space, hiring coaches (not required, but recommended!), and organizing schedules and logistics. In the future, this may change, depending on participation levels and interest.

data.question: How does this work?
data.answer:
After joining the mailing list, you'll receive announcement emails for upcoming performances, and whether the host is looking for additional performers to fill out a program. If so, their contact information will be available for you to discuss and organize directly with the host.

We encourage you to attend EBCM events to support other members, even if you're not playing!

You can also fill out a member profile (optional) to be listed on the site, and other people can reach out if they'd like to form a group or perhaps get together to sightread.

If you'd like to hire a coach for your group, please refer to the coaches directory to find someone who might be a good match. We suggest reaching out with your group's general availability for scheduling, the piece you'd like to work on, and how many sessions you'd like to book (we recommend 60 - 90 minutes per session). You may also want to ask their preferred method of payment.

data.question: Is there a fee to join?
data.answer:
No - joining and receiving updates is totally free.

The quarterly "official" EBCM-hosted recitals will be free to participants.

For other events, it will be up to the host whether you'll need to contribute something in order to perform (to cover rentals or other associated costs). Ideally, the fees will be split between all participants which should keep things reasonable!

data.question: How do I join or sign up?
data.answer:
Click the link below to join the mailing list. You should receive a notification that you've been added to the EBCM Google Group - if you don't hear anything after a few days, please reach out to ebchambermusic@gmail.com.

To sign up for a performance slot in a recital, you'll email the host/contact and go from there.

data.question: How do I get listed on the members page?
data.answer: Click the link below to fill out a Google Form to get added to the list. Check the members page to see information about fellow musicians!

data.question: Should my group hire a coach?
data.answer:
You don't have to, but you may find that it's helpful to get coach feedback before performing a piece.

The coaches in the directory on this site are all professionals who have specifically indicated that they'd like to be listed, and supporting them is just one way you can help foster a stronger local chamber music community.

data.question: What do we expect of performers?
data.answer:
Your group should present something you've worked on with the intention of performing it.

At minimum, you'll have met a couple of times in order to rehearse - coaching is optional.

data.question: Do we need to audition?
data.answer:
EBCM-hosted events welcome groups of all levels and no audition is necessary.

Other events may have criteria determined by the host. Whenever possible, the website/announcements will outline the requirements, but you can always email ebchambermusic@gmail.com if you have any questions.

data.question: Do I have to be located in the East Bay?
data.answer: Not at all! However, most events will likely take place in Berkeley and the immediate surrounding area.

data.question: I'd like to host a performance. What do I do?
data.answer:
Fantastic! As a host, you'll be responsible for your own event (fees, logistics, etc.) but EBCM can send announcements to members on your behalf - either looking for more performers, or simply advertising the concert.

You can send program information as you receive it to ebchambermusic@gmail.com and we'll update the site's homepage accordingly.

data.question: How can I support EBCM?
data.answer: The most helpful thing you can do other than participate in an EBCM event is to attend the events, and invite other people too!
